preservedExceptions.scope: Original Bootstrap logo assets, official brand artwork and raster images
preservedExceptions.reason: Artwork and brand provenance are preserved. Their intrinsic colours are outside the theme paint layer.

preservedExceptions.scope: Fenced instructional CSS/Sass, Code-only snippets, native source-reference swatches and upstream explanatory prose
preservedExceptions.reason: These document the original Bootstrap source or author-selected customization values. Live palette data and live hex labels are substituted separately to match the TQ tokens; native source code excerpts remain labelled reference material.
The final _tq-docs.scss stylesheet already overrides their active paint tokens in light and dark modes; original source and native geometry are retained.

preservedExceptions.scope: Third-party services and externally loaded content
preservedExceptions.reason: The local theme cannot recolour content or applications served outside this package.
